simple.meaning: דָּחָה (dâchâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to push down.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 11 times across Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Psalms 35:5. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּחָה (H1760).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: דָּחָה (dâchâh) / H1760 is traced through Psalms 35:5, Psalms 36:13, Psalms 62:4, Psalms 118:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Let them be as chaff before the wind,

timeline.evidenceText: Let them be as chaff before the wind,
They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place.
You pushed me back hard, to make me fall,
You pushed me back hard, to make me fall,
The proud have hidden a snare for me,
The wicked is brought down in his calamity,
He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
The Lord Yahweh, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says,
Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness.

definitions.full: H1760. dachah דָּחָה verb push, thrust (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic דְּחָא דְּחִי, , ; cf also Arabic , spread, extend , also throw, propel ) — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular suffix דְּחִיתַנִי Psa 118:13 ; Infinitive construct לִדְחוֺת 140:5 ; absolute דָּחֹה 118:13 ; Participle active דֹּחֶה 35:5 (read ᵐ5 דֹּחָם De Che); passive feminine הַדְּחוּיָה 62:4 ; — push , דָחָה דָּחֹה push violently figurative with accusative 118:13 followed by clause of purpose לִנְמֹּל , compare פעמי לִדְחוֺת 140:5 (Che trip up my feet ), & 35:5 (transpose דחה with רדפם 35:6 and read ᵐ5 דֹּחָם ; compare וַחֲלַקְלַקֹּת חשׁך יְהִידֿרכם v a , and Jer 23:12 ); pushed in (Che), in simile, passive participle, said of גָּדֵר wall Psa 62:4 (|| נטוי קיר ). Niph`al Imperfect יִדָּחֶה Prov 14:32 ; (3masculine plural יִדַּ֫חוּ Jer 23:12 is from דחח , if rightly pointed; נִדְחֵי Isa 11:12 ; 56:8 ; Psa 147:2 , see below נדח ); — be thrust or cast down , figurative of wicked Prov 14:32 , compare Psa 35:6 above Pu`al Perfect 3 plural דֹּחוּ Psalm 36:13 they are thrust down (|| נפלו & קום יכלו לא ). [ דָּחַח ] verb only Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine plural יִדַּ֫חוּ (Kö i. 377 ) Jer 23:12 they shall be thrust down , figurative, of wicked; read perhaps יִדָּח֫וּ , from דחה q. v. דחן (√ of following; perhaps compare Arabic smoke arose , hence become dusky, dingy, inclining to black ).
